batch: Robo Ice Cream UI Images - Management System Screens

images.original_filename: Robo Ice Cream - Home page before software (maybe we should not show it).png
images.description: android desktop home screen with pink gradient wallpaper showing application icons before software installation
images.notes: Shows the base android OS before Sweet Robo software is installed. May be used to document initial system state.

images.description: Numeric input keyboard overlay with 0-9 digits, operators, and Confirm/Clean buttons for parameter entry
images.notes: Shows the numeric keypad overlay used for entering values in management screens. Background shows stock setting interface.

images.original_filename: Robo Ice Cream - Input Password screen.png
images.description: Password input screen with masked entry showing six asterisks and numeric keypad with Confirm and Clean buttons
images.notes: Password entry interface for accessing management system. Shows 6-digit password format with asterisk masking.

images.original_filename: Robo Ice Cream - Management system - network connected - cooler is off (2nd red dot).png
images.description: Management system dashboard showing network connected (green) but cooler unavailable (red dot), with system info and menu buttons
images.notes: Shows system status with device info (CTT01015), network details, current version (VO1.57), and menu options. Red indicator shows cooler issue.

images.original_filename: Robo Ice Cream - Management system - no network.png
images.description: Management system dashboard showing unavailable network status (red dot) with loading spinner and system menu buttons
images.notes: Troubleshooting screen showing network connectivity issue. Loading indicator visible, useful for network setup documentation.

images.description: Management system dashboard with all systems normal, showing connected network and device information with menu options
images.notes: Main management dashboard showing all systems operational. Device test, system settings, stock settings, and other menu buttons visible.

images.description: Opening hours configuration screen showing weekly schedule with time slots 09:00-20:00 and day selection checkboxes
images.notes: Shows opening hours interface with start/end times for each day, checkboxes for day selection, and closing time configuration.

images.description: Parameter settings screen showing advanced configuration options including ice cream settings, jar adding intervals, and tank temperature
images.notes: Shows detailed parameter configuration with numeric values for machine operation, mixing times, temperatures, and intervals.

summary.notes: These are management system UI screenshots from the Robo Ice Cream software showing admin interfaces, configuration screens, and system status displays.
